notes.title: Non-VR Version Available!
notes.content:
Version 0.8.60 update:
[list]
[*]Non-VR Version Available.
[*]When no VR system detected, the app will run in Non-VR mode.
[*]Note: Non-VR is not the main focus of this app, so it is not polished for Non-VR systems.
[/list]
[h2]Keyboard And Mouse Controls[/h2]

[b]Z[/b] - Zoom In
[b]X[/b] - Zoom Out
[b]Left Shift[/b] - Fast Zoom

[b]Space[/b] - Highlight Objects

[b]Mouse Wheel[/b] - Zoom
[b]Left Mouse Button Drag[/b] - Rotate
[b]Left Mouse Button Click[/b] - Select Object

* Added multiverse theory

notes.title: Windows Mixed Reality supported
notes.content:
Version 0.8.43
- [b]Windows Mixed Reality[/b] headsets and controllers supported.
- Vive Cosmos should be supported, but I don't have that headset so I cannot test it.
- Narrative text window is better anchored.
- Small bug fixes.
